text:
anya: starting a canary of redwood-v2-awq; after ~2k reqs we see token repetition + entropy spike

sara: replayed locally, same pattern. logits collapse, kv-cache hit-rate drops and outputs start looping

mike: can you paste the canary config?

anya: ```
model: redwood-v2-awq
quant: awq
group_size: 64
act_quant: true
per_channel_act: false
clip_threshold: 1e-3
soft_calib: false
```

julia: that `per_channel_act:false` with group_size=64 is suspicious. We've seen per-layer scale drift when activations are shared across large groups

sara: repro steps I ran:
1) replay 2k session traces against canary
2) track `top1_prob`, `entropy`, `kv_hit_rate`, per-layer quant scales
3) divergence usually at token ~20

mike: logs show `top1_prob -> 0.01`, `entropy -> 6.8`, and `kv_hit_rate` dropping from 0.92 -> 0.3 over ~10 tokens

anya: quick mitigation test: set `group_size=8`, `per_channel_act=true`, `clip_threshold=5e-4`. ran 5k requests on staging, stable; ppl vs float baseline within 0.7%

devx-bot: canary rollout paused (rule: ppl_delta > 2.0) — reason: act-quant instability alert

mike: proposed bakeoff plan:
- sweep group_size in [4,8,16,32,64]
- per_channel_act in [true,false]
- toggle `soft_calib` for first 200 tokens
- collect ppl, top1_prob, entropy, kv_hit_rate, per-layer scale drift, and cost metrics
- 50-prompt eval repeated 3x for repeatability

julia: add a per-layer `scale_drift` signal; if any layer's scale oscillates >10% during warmup, flag and fallback that layer to FP16 in serving binary

sara: also include an embedding-preserve test — act-quant sometimes interacts badly with rotary/pos enc on this arch

anya: rollout/traffic plan: 0.1% -> 1% -> 5% with continuous eval and automatic revert on thresholds

mike: long-term: add automated sensitivity sweep to onboarding pipeline to pick AWQ defaults (prefer group_size small + per_channel_act=true unless cost too high) and store tradeoffs in the model catalog

julia: note for bench comparisons: record token latency tail and cost-per-token for each config; sometimes group_size=8 costs more but saves from instability-related retries

anya: opening ticket now: `/ticket create "AWQ sensitivity sweep and canary mitigation"` assigning to eng-ml

sara: thanks — scheduling the bake and will post logs + eval summary here when done :thumbsup:
